purpose: Appointments canceled or no-shows in the period, with reason, doctor and patient.
tips: Choose the filters and tap «Generate»: the report isn't calculated on its own.
Helps spot time slots with many no-shows and step up reminders.

reports.cancelaciones.section.filters.label: Filters
reports.cancelaciones.section.filters.description: Doctor, reason and type (cancellation or no-show).

reports.cancelaciones.section.kpi.label: Indicators
reports.cancelaciones.section.kpi.description: Total cancellations, main reason, most affected doctor and most frequent patient.

reports.cancelaciones.section.results.label: Results
reports.cancelaciones.section.results.description: Charts by reason, day and hour, and the details of each cancellation.
